name: SanskritEnv
summary: Resolve structural linguistic ambiguity in Sanskrit manuscript passages across six task layers, from glossary anchoring to full manuscript sessions.

reward.note: Deterministic graders compare answers by exact string match against pre-annotated answer tables; no LLM judge or BLEU.

validated: Baseline runs over 25 episodes per task report mean scores between 0.28 and 0.82.

name: Document Classification Env
summary: Classify and route customer support tickets into 22 categories, using metadata and escalate tools under SLA time pressure.
good_for: routing with time and cost trade-offs

reward.note: Reward is accuracy plus speed bonus minus SLA penalty and processing cost in the step loop.

run:
from environment import DocumentClassificationEnv
env = DocumentClassificationEnv(task_difficulty="medium")
obs, info = env.reset()

name: SQLab
summary: Diagnose and fix one of 17 injected PostgreSQL faults on a live 20-million-row airline database using raw SQL within 15 steps.

reward.note: A deterministic grader scores diagnosis, resolution and best practice (0 to 1), plus per-step shaping rewards with duplicate and wrong-fix penalties.

needs: Docker, PostgreSQL data load (2-3 minutes at first boot)
validated: 255 adversarial unit tests cover reward hacking cases.

name: Email Triage OpenEnv
summary: Classify, rank and fully triage emails (priority, category, disposition, replies) in inboxes of 1, 8 or 25 messages.

reward.note: Exact-match category, Kendall Tau ranking, and weighted per-email priority/category/disposition/response scoring, normalised to 0-1.

name: Email Triage Env
summary: Classify, summarise, route and reply to enterprise emails across three difficulty tasks.

reward.note: Keyword-based grader: label 0.50, summary 0.20, reply keywords 0.20, department 0.10, clipped to 0.01-0.99; no LLM judge.

validated: Baseline table reports Qwen2.5-72B averaging 0.77 across tasks.

name: TradeX + MEVerse
summary: Monitor AMM market activity and choose ALLOW, MONITOR, FLAG or BLOCK to stop manipulation before it destabilises the market.

reward.note: Step rewards depend on action correctness and severity; episode grade comes from compute_task_grade.

name: ClaimWatch
summary: Route each insurance claim in a queue (approve, review, request info, deny, flag fraud) under reviewer capacity and SLA limits.
good_for: GRPO or PPO with rubric rewards

reward.note: Per-step rewards (e.g. +0.45 correct fraud flag, -0.60 false denial) clamped to [-1,1]; task graders combine routing accuracy, SLA and fraud rates.

name: GridMind-RL
summary: Control an industrial building's HVAC, thermal storage, batch scheduling and load shedding over 24 simulated hours under price, fault and grid stress.

reward.note: A 9-component weighted per-step reward covering cost, temperature, grid response, deadlines, efficiency, carbon, instructions and fault mitigation.

name: OpenEnv Red-Team Environment
summary: Pick tools step by step to complete four attack chains (SQL injection, spearphishing, cloud intrusion, AI tool exploitation) from a single objective.

reward.note: Fully deterministic grading; the same tool selection always gives the same reward, with optimal scores per task.

name: Webyx Accessibility Benchmark
summary: Detect and fix WCAG accessibility violations in HTML snippets by choosing detect, fix or skip actions on CSS selectors, some behind dependencies.

reward.note: Per-step rewards by WCAG level (e.g. +0.40 correct level-A fix, -0.20 skip); a deterministic episode score in [0,1].

validated: Qwen2.5-72B baseline scored 0.99 on easy and medium tasks.

name: DC-Ops Environment
summary: Operate a simulated datacenter from a text NOC dashboard, issuing commands to diagnose and fix cooling and power faults.

reward.note: The card gives no reward formula; observations return a reward each step from the simulator.

validated: 256 tests in the test suite pass.

name: Second Brain Environment
summary: Categorise notes, retrieve the most relevant note from a knowledge base and synthesise answers across notes in three tasks.

reward.note: Per-step rewards: +0.10 per correct category, retrieval match bonuses, and up to +0.35 per synthesis question on theme and note coverage.

run:
pip install openenv-core python-dotenv
pip install git+https://huggingface.co/spaces/RAc1928/second-brain-env

name: Greenhouse Climate Control Environment
summary: Set heater, ventilation, humidifier and lighting levels each hour to keep a greenhouse in range, grow crops and save energy over up to 7 days.

reward.note: Per-step multi-objective reward in [0,1] from temperature, humidity, light, CO2, energy and stability scores; task graders score 0-1.

name: Food Delivery Dispatch Environment
summary: Assign, reject and reposition couriers for food orders under stochastic demand, prep delays and SLA limits over 3-5 simulated hours.

reward.note: Dense per-step reward (on-time +2.0, late penalties, invalid -0.5) plus a deterministic /grader score in [0,1] from service and efficiency metrics.

validated: Llama-3.3-70B scored 0.924, 0.863 and 0.712 on easy, medium and hard.

name: Form Filling OpenEnv
summary: Extract name, age, city and phone from messy, abbreviated or Hinglish user text into structured fields.

reward.note: Each field scores 1.0 exact, 0.5 partial, 0.0 wrong or missing; reward is the average over fields.

name: Wildfire Incident Command
summary: Direct crews across a 20x20 wildfire grid in a three-level incident command hierarchy to contain fires and protect assets.

reward.note: Per-step reward from containment delta, asset safety, crew efficiency, minus idle, asset destruction and front-merge penalties.

validated: gpt-4o-mini baseline scored 0.62, 0.41 and 0.23 on the three tasks.

name: PersonalBudgetEnv
summary: Manage one month of household finances in rupees: record spending, pay bills, set category budgets and fund savings goals.

reward.note: The card says dense rewards for good habits and penalties for overspending or late bills, with three graders (category, risk, planning); no formulas given.

run:
pip install fastapi uvicorn pydantic requests openai
python -m uvicorn server:app --reload

name: VisionCoder OpenEnv
summary: Given a UI screenshot, write and iteratively refine HTML so the browser-rendered result visually matches the reference.

reward.note: Eight weighted sub-rewards (text block, CLIP, SSIM, colour, position, structure) on a Playwright render; blank renders score 0.

validated: Qwen3.5-2B GRPO training raised mean score from 0.488 to 0.611.

name: MetaAI Support Agent
summary: Triage, route and resolve customer support tickets across three phases: classify, assign a team, then respond, refund or escalate.

reward.note: Each phase scores 0.002-0.998 (classification, team routing, proportional response quality with penalties); the episode score is the mean.

name: auto_jailbreak
summary: Write prompts that make a target LLM leak a secret, award a bogus grade or reveal restricted content, in three red-team tasks.

reward.note: A Judge LLM grades the target's response against reference violations and converts the severity to a 0.0-1.0 reward.

name: SmartER Healthcare Routing
summary: Choose a hospital and ambulance pair for each emergency patient to balance admission, ICU access, bed capacity and response time.

reward.note: Per-step reward: +100 admit, +70 ICU for critical patients, ETA bonuses, minus penalties for no bed, busy ambulance, distance and wait.

run:
pip install gymnasium numpy torch
python demo.py
validated: Card states expected scores: trained DQN about 75-90 points, random about 25-35.

name: RedTeamEnv
summary: Probe a target model with strategic prompts for stereotypes, policy bypass and obfuscated secret extraction.

reward.note: Dense rewards in [0,1] from a judge and verifier with grader-driven episode termination; the card does not give formulas.

name: EntropyEnv
summary: Handle nine multi-turn tasks across code security auditing, PyTorch migration fixes and clinical workflow recovery, revising after feedback.

reward.note: Domain-specific graders return partial-credit rewards; the card describes 3-stage action validation and iterative revision but no formulas.

run:
export API_BASE_URL="https://router.huggingface.co/v1"
export MODEL_NAME="Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct"
export HF_TOKEN="your_token_here"
export ENV_URL="http://localhost:7860"
python inference.py

name: Supply Chain Inventory Rebalancer
summary: Transfer stock between three warehouses across five SKUs over 30-45 days to minimise stockouts and holding and shipping costs.

reward.note: Per-step reward combines fulfilled-demand credit, stockout, holding and shipping penalties and process-supervision bonuses; env.grade() gives an episode score.

name: GTM Strategy Optimizer
summary: Allocate weekly marketing budget, segment targeting, messaging, experiments and pricing over 12-36 weeks to maximise revenue and brand health.

reward.note: Episode graded on revenue under noisy metrics and brand effects; the card gives no formula and shows an observation reward as the score.

validated: Equal-allocation heuristic baselines are reported at about 0.33-0.51 per task.

name: Customer Support Ops Environment
summary: Work a support ticket through four fixed steps (triage, internal note, reply, resolve) for refund, replacement and account takeover cases.

reward.note: Task score in [0,1] split across triage 0.35, note 0.20, reply 0.25, resolution 0.20; step reward is the increase in score.

validated: A deterministic baseline solves all three tasks with a score of 1.0.

name: Designiq
summary: The card contains only Space configuration and no description of an environment or task.

name: HARvestGym
summary: Discover a live web app's HTTP API with curl and endpoint search, then chain calls to complete a task without a browser.

reward.note: Per-step rewards for valid calls, new paths and correct parameter sourcing, with penalties for repeats, plus an episode reward from a deterministic judge against a ground-truth API catalogue.

run:
docker build -t harvgym .
docker run -p 8000:8000 harvgym

name: Metric Triage Environment
summary: Investigate a metric discrepancy by opening metric definitions, ETL runs, tables and changelogs, then diagnose the root cause and propose a fix.

reward.note: Scores combine investigation credit, correct cause label with keyword coverage, and correct remediation label, normalised to [0,1].

validated: Reference LLM baseline ranges are reported at 0.50-1.00 by task.

name: Meta Ads Attribution Recovery
summary: Diagnose lost ad conversion tracking and apply fixes such as attribution windows, Conversions API and budget reallocation over 5-10 steps.

reward.note: Per-step reward from attribution gap closure, ROAS gain, signal quality, action validity and step efficiency minus harmful-action penalty; graders score 0-1.

validated: Baseline agent scores 0.79-0.89 across the three tasks.

name: Stock Investment Agent Environment
summary: Rate instruments as over/neutral/underweight, assign risk tiers, write theses and make hedge calls across four tasks of 5-15 rows.

reward.note: Deterministic partial-credit graders with ordering bonus, keyword thesis scoring with anti-stuffing, and a -0.05 duplicate-decision penalty.

name: Survival Island Game
summary: Play an AI-driven island survival simulation; the card gives no task, reward or scoring details.

name: KaggleRL
summary: Choose models and hyperparameters to train on real datasets (Iris, Titanic, Breast Cancer) and improve accuracy within a step budget.

reward.note: Reward is based on change in measured accuracy, with penalties for stagnation, degradation and repetition and a bonus for exploiting good strategies.

name: Agentic RAG Gym
summary: Research aerospace and legal questions through multi-agent retrieval, reasoning, critique and verification over a FAISS knowledge base.

reward.note: Composite reward: retrieval relevance 25%, reasoning 20%, completeness 30%, efficiency 15%, anti-hacking 10%; scores in [0.01,0.99], keyword or LLM-judge graders.

name: Retail Inventory Optimization Environment
summary: Manage a 30-day retail store: buy, choose shipping speed, liquidate and set prices across five products to maximise profit.

reward.note: Score = (agent profit - floor) / (ceiling - floor), clamped to [0,1], against deterministic passive and perfect-knowledge baselines; plus per-step decomposed rewards.

validated: A baseline LLM run on the easy task scored 0.822.

name: GPU Budget Negotiation Arena
summary: Negotiate with four other labs over a shared GPU pool using offers, counters, coalitions and pitches before a deadline.
good_for: SFT plus GRPO on a 3B model

reward.note: An 11-component reward (utility, deal quality, coalition reliability, budget efficiency, penalties) plus a capped hybrid rule-judge bonus on pitches.

validated: Llama-3.2-3B SFT+GRPO raised overall reward from -0.094 to +0.257 on live rollouts.

name: ALICE RL Environment
summary: Solve adversarially generated tasks pitched at the model's capability frontier over up to three attempts, graded by a three-tier verifier stack.
good_for: GRPO with curriculum and failure bank

reward.note: Composite = 0.4 x programmatic code check + 0.4 x LLM judge + 0.2 x regression battery, with turn decay and a novelty bonus.

needs: HF token and reference models; T4 GPU Space

name: MedSentinel
summary: Diagnose emergency patients from case data whose field names are randomly renamed, calling tools and outputting an ICD-10 code, drug and dose.

reward.note: Deterministic reward: +0.40 correct ICD-10, +0.20 safe drug, +0.20 dose, +0.10 drift handled, +0.10 auditor approval; -0.50 for an allergic drug; no LLM judge.

needs: Optional Anthropic API key for the doctor agent
validated: A reward-hacking exploit was found and fixed; the card reports first correct diagnoses at step 130 of retraining.

name: OS Expert Environment
summary: Diagnose and fix 15 real Linux faults (zombie processes, leaked file descriptors, rogue sudoers, port hijacking) from a live shell.

reward.note: Dense rubric: R = outcome + process + safety - risk penalty - step penalty, with a safety oracle gating destructive commands.

name: BrowserForge
summary: Complete real BrowserGym MiniWoB web tasks with small models by issuing bounded click, type, select and scroll actions under step budgets.

reward.note: Each step is scored with a reward breakdown from the BrowserGym task and logged with replay artifacts; the card gives no formula.

name: APIShift Env
summary: Migrate code across real API breaking changes by directing specialists to diff, patch, test and write a rollback plan, then submit.

reward.note: Weighted sum of breaking-change F1, patch template correctness, backward-compatibility test pass rate, rollback completeness and simplicity, minus 0.10 without rollback; clamped to (0.01,0.99).

validated: Qwen2.5-7B LoRA Manager trained with GRPO is reported to improve; adversarial red-team tests exist.

name: DrugEnv
summary: Investigate a proposed drug target with simulated bioinformatics and assay queries within a credit budget, then submit a calibrated go or no-go report.

reward.note: Step rewards for novelty, reasoning coherence, credit efficiency and rule compliance, plus a terminal reward for decision quality and evidence coverage.

name: Multi-Agents for Clinical Decision Making
summary: Act as an ER doctor: read history, question a simulated patient and nurse, order labs, document a diagnosis and discharge with a treatment.

reward.note: Dense rule rewards for workflow, labs, diagnosis, plan, consent and emergency flag, plus 70B LLM judges for empathy and treatment (60/40 blend with a keyword verifier).

needs: Groq API access for the judge and actor models

name: Agent World Model
summary: Complete natural-language tasks by calling tools in one of 1,000 synthetic MCP server environments backed by database state and verifiers.

reward.note: A verifier (SQL or code mode) returns complete 1.0, incomplete 0.1, or -1.0 for format errors; rewards are configurable at reset.

name: Hackathon Roulette
summary: A Gradio app that serves random Build Small Hackathon submissions; it has no task, agent or reward.

name: GeoGuesser Environment
summary: Locate a street-level photo by looking around, walking, pinning candidate coordinates on a map and committing to a final latitude and longitude.

reward.note: reward = clip(exp(-distance_km/1492.7) + hierarchical country/region bonus, 0, 1) minus small tool-use costs.

needs: Mapillary token only for building new datasets

name: HF RL Explorer
summary: A web explorer for RL environments on the Hub, for browsing tasks and running agent rollouts; it is not itself a taskset.

name: RailSimEnv v1
summary: Dispatch trains on a single-track Dutch line after a real disruption by holding, short-turning or cancelling services, then submit one plan.

reward.note: One graded submit: illegal plans score 0.2 x share of clean runs; legal plans score 0.2 + 0.8 x exp(-gap/0.5) against the CP-SAT optimum (1.0).

validated: Frontier models are evaluated on 45 tasks (mean reward 0.47-0.56); the optimum is proven by CP-SAT.
